title: analyze checks the shape of its arguments before it looks for jitso/prices.json, so a bad argument is exit 2 even without a price table
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES R6, defect N-28). analyze checks its argument shape (one launch id of the exact form, or --transcript with one path ending .jsonl) first, then the project, then jitso/prices.json, like close and reap. This project has no prices file and the last step runs outside a git checkout, and every step is still exit 2 with the usage line. The oracle loads the prices first and exits 3, so the exit code FAILS on TS.
